recorder_scope: Public task pseudonym supplied to the native recorder, not an account or machine name. Skills CLI has no separate stack/winner component id; this supplemental receipt binds its checks without inventing one.

install.command: systemd-run --user --scope -p CPUWeight=idle bash adoption/bootstrap-linux.sh --only skills --only tavily-cli --only orx --skip-system-packages

vendor_routes.skills: checksum-verified npm archive in isolated prefix
vendor_routes.orx: checksum-verified release tarball in isolated prefix

install.scope: Existing bootstrap functions and pin sources only; existing ecosystem bin already on PATH; no profile/PATH edit, client install, core refresh, authentication or provider operation. npm also publishes the vendor add-skill alias.

inverse.scope: Same bootstrap selection in a new disposable prefix; live host installation retained.
inverse.install_command: ECO_INSTALL_ROOT=<owned-prefix> systemd-run --user --scope -p CPUWeight=idle bash adoption/bootstrap-linux.sh --only skills --only tavily-cli --only orx --skip-system-packages

commands.command: UV_TOOL_DIR=<owned-prefix>/python-tools UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR=<owned-prefix>/bin uv tool uninstall tavily-cli

inverse.readback: No skills, add-skill, tvly or orx executable or dangling publication link remains in the disposable prefix.

retained_boundaries.pdftotext: qualified-prefix-only: current Poppler 26.09.0 recipe is Mac-specific, makes no global default, and does not qualify Linux. No Linux bootstrap pin exists; Linux absence remains a platform gap, not a pass.
retained_boundaries.agent-browser: held; no install or browser download performed
retained_boundaries.credentials: No credential/configuration read, sign-in or live provider call performed.

limitations: Version and installed-skill checks do not establish live web-research acceptance.
The existing tavily-cli sdist digest is an independent cross-check; the native uv route resolves the exact version and its dependencies through its index. This repair does not add dependency locking.
This host run used the proposed bootstrap source before review; it is not a platform-status promotion.
